summary: This Makefile defines a collection of convenient shortcut commands for managing a Dockerized Joomla development environment. Each target (like 'adminer', 'bash', 'up', 'down') bundles together related Docker operations—starting services, opening browsers, viewing logs, and stopping containers—so developers can run complex multi-step processes with a single command.

explanations.2: The @printf command prints a formatted message in yellow bold text (\e[1;033m sets the color) that tells users the default credentials and URL for Adminer database tool; the %% syntax appears to be template variables that get replaced elsewhere.
explanations.4: This docker run command starts an Adminer container in detached mode, connects it to the joomladb database via a network link, exposes port 8088, and automatically removes the container when it stops.
explanations.5: The leading dash (-) tells Make to ignore if this command fails; sensible-browser is a utility that opens the URL in whatever browser is available, and the & runs it in the background so the script continues.
explanations.8: @printf prints an instruction message in yellow bold text explaining what the bash target does.
explanations.9: This executes an interactive shell session (/bin/sh) inside the running 'joomla' container, letting the developer run commands directly in that container.
explanations.12: The 'code .' command opens VS Code in the current directory so you can edit project files.
explanations.18: explorer.exe is Windows's file explorer; this opens the current directory in a graphical folder browser on Windows systems.
explanations.28: The leading dash allows this command to fail gracefully; it tries to open the website in a browser but won't crash if the browser command isn't available.
explanations.31: docker compose up --detach starts all services defined in docker-compose.yml in the background (detached mode) without blocking the terminal.
explanations.36: Similar to line 4, this starts a phpMyAdmin container linked to the database, exposes it on port 8089, and sets up networking.
